title: Dataverse: build solutions with coding agents using the Dataverse plugin and Work IQ
summary: Hold: the governance notes recommend a server control for directly authenticated tools that it does not govern. The environment participation path also adds a step absent from its cited instructions; the allowed-client REST operation and published billing statements are supported.

claims.claim: The cited Work IQ participation instructions give Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Work IQ.
claims.quote:
Select Manage, and select the environment.
Select Settings > Product > Features.
Locate Work IQ.
claims.fix: Replace the path in controls[0].ui and its rendered row with 'Manage > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Work IQ' in the Power Platform admin center. The cited participation instructions do not include an 'Environments' step.

claims.claim: Turning off the tenant setting prevents Copilot Chat and Dataverse sharing even when an app is configured to share.

claims.where: Governance controls: App Access Control path
claims.claim: App Access Control is under Security > Identity & access > App Access Control in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Power Platform admin center.
Select Security > Identity & access.
Select App Access Control.

claims.claim: App Access controls which applications can access underlying environment data.
claims.quote: App Access is the mechanism used to choose which applications, including agentic applications such as Copilot Cowork, are allowed to access data in a particular environment.

claims.where: Governance controls: 'For those, use the server control'
claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP server control is a governance lever for the plugin's directly authenticated tools.
claims.quote: Other tools used by the plugin, such as the Dataverse SDK for Python and Power Platform CLI, authenticate directly and aren't subject to these MCP-specific controls. Their requests still require Dataverse authorization.
claims.fix: Replace 'For those, use the server control, App Access Control (Security > Identity & access > App Access Control in the Power Platform admin center) and the developer's Dataverse security roles.' with 'For directly authenticated plugin tools, Dataverse authorization and the authenticated identity's permissions still apply.' Keep the preceding statement about the separate Work IQ MCP server Block control.

isenabled | Edm.Boolean | Display name: Is Enabled

claims.where: Governance controls: role-based business skill sharing

claims.quote: An administrator must assign users the Skill Sharing Role, either directly or through a team. Users must also have the security role that the skill is shared with.

claims.claim: The checklist's instruction to audit business-skill use and ownership has a corresponding governance-control row.
claims.quote:
Audit use of business skills and who owns them.
The controls table lists environment participation, tenant Copilot availability, Dataverse MCP, Work IQ MCP, and coding-plugin access; it has no business-skill audit or ownership control.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet 'Audit use of business skills and who owns them.' It names a control not represented in the table; do not add an unverified control row.
